verse.verse_1: When the sun shall be folded up,
verse.verse_2: when the stars shall scatter away,
verse.verse_3: when the mountains shall be set in motion,
verse.verse_4: when the ten-months pregnant camels shall be abandoned,
verse.verse_5: when the savage beasts shall be brought together,
verse.verse_6: when the seas shall be set boiling,
verse.verse_7: when the souls shall be rejoined (with their bodies),
verse.verse_8: and when the girl-child buried alive shall be asked:
verse.verse_9: for what offence was she killed?
verse.verse_10: and when the scrolls of (men's) deeds shall be unfolded,
verse.verse_11: and when Heaven is laid bare;
verse.verse_14: then shall each person know what he has brought along.
verse.verse_15: No indeed; I swear by the alternating stars
verse.verse_17: and by the night as it recedes,
verse.verse_18: and the morn as it breathes.
verse.verse_19: Verily this is the word of a noble message-bearer;
verse.verse_20: one mighty and held in honour with the Lord of the Throne;
verse.verse_21: there he is obeyed and held trustworthy.
verse.verse_22: (O people of Makkah), your companion is not mad;
verse.verse_23: he indeed saw the message-bearer on the clear horizon;
verse.verse_24: nor does he grudge (conveying this knowledge about) the Unseen;
verse.verse_25: nor is it a word of an accursed Satan.
verse.verse_26: Where to are you then heading?
verse.verse_27: It is nothing but Good Counsel for everyone in the world,
verse.verse_28: for everyone of you who wishes to follow the Straight Way;
verse.verse_29: but your wishing will not avail unless Allah, the Lord of the Universe, so wishes.
